svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 14 — "Who Were You?" — Section 3 wing-pack glyph examination
svg.desc: Page 14: 4 panels in 3 tiers (banner / mid-tier-tall / half-half). Luma's wing-pack flight examination of the simplified human-height glyph. Vast billboard-sized inscription dwarfs her at floor level. She deploys wings, hovers face-to-face, hand pressed against stone — confirming reality. Translation HUD reveals primer fragments (GREETING / SELF: FRIEND / INTENT: TEACH). Theodore at iron grate above watches the distant blue-violet glow. Capture-mode lenses photograph everything. "Who were you?"
